name: Berge knot
rephrased: A Berge knot is a special type of mathematical knot in the 3-sphere defined by its relationship to a genus-two Heegaard surface, meaning it lies on this surface and intersects a meridian disk on each side exactly once, making it doubly primitive
implication_form: If a knot is doubly primitive, then it is a Berge knot.
explained: a specific type of knot in the 3-sphere that lies on a genus two Heegaard surface and meets a meridian disk in each of the two bounding handlebodies exactly once
